Name: Shemaiah, the Levite
Summary: Shemaiah was one of the Levites sent with Jehoshaphat's princes to teach the book of the law throughout Judah.
KeyStory: With the princes went Levites, including Shemaiah, and they taught in Judah with the book of the law of the LORD.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
